field_gate.value: Located in the historic West End, this venue features a 700-square-foot second-story patio and a hacienda-inspired interior with warm lighting. It offers a deep selection of agave spirits and scratch-made Mexican cuisine in a sophisticated, inviting atmosphere.
field_gate.evidence: In the heart of Greenville's historic West End, a stone's throw from the Riverwalk and Falls Park, The Matador brings the vibrant flavors of Mexico and the world of tequila and agave spirits to Greenville. The restaurant's interior is stylish, sophisticated, warm, and inviting, featuring two bars, one on each level, and an expansive rooftop deck.

field_gate.value: Located on a four-acre property in downtown Inman, this brewery and full-service restaurant features a spacious taproom and a dedicated 21+ mezzanine level. Guests can enjoy house-made craft beers, seltzers, and cocktails alongside a menu of burgers, wraps, and wings.
field_gate.evidence: This location is situated on nearly 4 acres with a 9000 sq ft brewery, taproom and a full restaurant. From our wide variety of exceptionally balanced craft beers and hard seltzers to our guest ciders, wines and mixed drinks, there is something for everyone at Holliday! Our restaurant serves delicious craft burgers, wraps, fish tacos, wings, salads, and a variety of apps that pair well with our beers.
